tips.text: Cast Emberstrike before you attack a camp or an enemy; each hit lowers its cooldown, so keep attacking to use it again and again.
Use Inferno Aegis when you start a camp; the shield and speed boost help you clear, and the blast hits everything around you.
Use Inferno Aegis when you gank; the speed boost gets bigger when you run toward enemy champions.
Aim Molten Burst at a fleeing enemy; it leaves them slowed so you can catch up and attack.
Keep hitting enemy champions to fill your Dragon Fury, and cast Dragon's Descent once it is full to fly into the fight.
Fight enemies who are grouped up while you are in Dragon Form; Molten Burst then pierces through them all and leaves a burning trail.
Take down large monsters and enemy champions; each kill adds Scalemail stacks, which make you tougher.
Stay close to Aatrox and keep attacking. Emberstrike and your Fury grow from hitting him, and he beats you if you stay at a distance.
Use Inferno Aegis when you fight Aatrox. The shield and speed help you close in, and the blast hurts him when it goes off.
Use Molten Burst on Aatrox when he backs away, so he is slowed and cannot easily dodge or chase.
Cast Dragon's Descent in fights where Aatrox's Infernal Chains would pull you. It makes you Unstoppable as you fly in.
Walk to the side of the hit zones of The Darkin Blade, then fight back when he finishes the swings.
Use Inferno Aegis when Ambessa jumps on you; the shield grows with enemy champions nearby, and the blast hurts her if she stays.
Fight Ambessa in Dragon Form; Molten Burst then pierces and leaves a burning trail, and she stays slowed as you chase.
Do not fight her while Dragon's Descent is unready; she hits hard and your Dragon Fury runs out quickly.
Chain Emberstrike attacks on her; each hit shortens its cooldown and the extra casts add damage in a short trade.
Stay away from Amumu's Bandage Toss line; walking beside minions makes it harder for him to start a fight.
Don't stand in Despair when you can avoid it; it hurts more the more Health you have.
Don't clump with allies when Amumu has Curse of the Sad Mummy ready.
Use Inferno Aegis when you walk toward Amumu; the shield and speed help you close in and trade.
Fight Bel'Veth when Inferno Aegis is ready; the shield grows with each enemy champion nearby, and its blast hurts her when you pop it.
Use Molten Burst to slow Bel'Veth when she dashes, so she cannot easily slip away or line up her attacks.
Chain your Emberstrike casts between attacks so you deal extra damage in every swing of a short trade.
Take fights early before Bel'Veth stacks up attack speed; she gets much stronger the longer the game goes.
Do not run away in a straight line; Bel'Veth's Void Surge dashes catch you, and Above and Below can knock you up.
Use Dragon's Descent to fly out of or into a fight. You can't be pushed around while flying, and the fear stops her from attacking.
Close the gap with Dragon's Descent, since Brand wants to stay at range. Its fear leaves him unable to cast for a moment.
Dodge Sear and Pillar of Flame. Brand needs one of them to land before his combo can start.
Sidestep Sear after Brand has hit you with another ability. If you are ablaze, it stuns you.
Use Inferno Aegis when you walk in on Brand. It shields you and speeds you up toward him.
Stay away from your allies when Pyroclasm goes out. It starts slowly, so you have time to move.
Cast Molten Burst at Briar as she leaps in or runs away; the slowed enemy is easier to catch and hit with Emberstrike.
Use Inferno Aegis when Briar jumps on you; the shield soaks her burst and the blast hurts her when it ends.
Fight Briar in Dragon Form when you can; the bigger fireball and the heal from Inferno Aegis beat her bleed healing in a long fight.
Briar's Head Rush stun is short and lands on whoever she picks. Keep your cooldowns ready so you can trade right back once it ends.
Keep your distance early. Darius is strongest when he can trade close up, so make him walk into your Molten Burst instead of brawling.
Cast Inferno Aegis as Darius closes in. The shield soaks his damage and the speed boost lets you walk away or turn and fight.
Fire Molten Burst right after Darius uses Apprehend. He is left without his pull and can be harassed.
Don't stand in a tight line with allies when you fight in Dragon Form. Darius's Decimate hits everyone around him and heals him for each champion hit.
Step out of the outer edge of Decimate. Its handle does less damage, so stay close to him rather than at the blade's edge.
Slow him with Molten Burst when you want to leave a fight. Crippling Strike will slow you hard if he reaches you first.
Don't fight him at low health once he has built up bleeding. Noxian Guillotine hits harder with each stack and can finish you.
Save Dragon's Descent for when Diana pulls you in, since you are Unstoppable while flying and can escape her pull and fight back.
Hit Diana with Molten Burst as she dashes in; it leaves her slowed and gives you room to fight back.
Use Inferno Aegis as the fight starts; the shield soaks her burst and the explosion hurts her when she stays close.
Chain Emberstrike casts with your attacks once Diana is on you; her low defenses mean sustained hits add up quickly.
Keep Mundo from getting free Infected Bonesaw hits; the slow lets him catch you and he heals when it lands.
Skip using crowd control to lock Mundo down; Goes Where He Pleases blocks the first one, so bait it out first.
Hit Mundo with burst after he uses Maximum Dosage begins; if he lives he heals through it, so fight when it is on cooldown.
Use Inferno Aegis when Mundo is next to you; the shield grows with nearby enemies and the blast hurts him.
Step on Mundo's canister to destroy it so he cannot heal from it.
Stay close to Ekko and keep hitting him; Shyvana's power comes from fighting up close, and Ekko wants to trade at range.
Use Inferno Aegis when you walk onto Ekko; the shield and extra speed help you close in and take his burst.
Hit Ekko with Molten Burst to keep him slowed so he can't easily escape your Emberstrike hits.
Cast Dragon's Descent on Ekko once he has used Chronobreak. He can't rewind out of the fight, and you can finish him.
Step out of the Parallel Convergence circle when you see its image appear. Being stunned in it will cost you the fight.
Do not stand in melee with Evelynn after she marks you with Allure. Move away or keep allies near you so she cannot reach you uncontested.
Use Inferno Aegis when Evelynn jumps in; the shield and speed help you survive her burst, and its blast hurts her.
Use Molten Burst to slow Evelynn as she comes in, then fight back with Emberstrike.
Keep your health up. Evelynn's Last Caress deals huge damage to low-health targets, so retreat before you drop low.
Be careful in brush and when Fiddlesticks stands still. A scarecrow may be him, and Terrify, Reap or Bountiful Harvest can fear you.
Do not walk into the middle of Reap. You will be slowed and silenced, so step out of the area to stay free of the silence.
Fiddlesticks is fragile. Once you reach him, hit him with Emberstrike and use Inferno Aegis to shield against his burst.
Use Dragon's Descent to escape or cut through Crowstorm. You are Unstoppable while you fly, so his channel cannot hold you in place.
Move away from your allies when he channels Crowstorm, and do not stand in it. It hits everyone in the area for several seconds.
Stay close to Graves; Shyvana is weak when kept at range, so use Dragon's Descent to land on him instead of walking up through his shots.
Use Inferno Aegis before you step into his range; the shield soaks his burst and the speed boost closes the gap.
Aim Molten Burst at him when he tries to back away; it leaves him slowed so you can catch him.
Do not fight inside his Smoke Screen; it slows you and hides what is outside. Step out and the slow ends.
Hold Dragon's Descent until you are in Dragon Form's reach of him; the fear stops him from shooting for a moment.
Use Molten Burst to slow Gwen as she tries to run, then hit her with attacks; she cannot be targeted while she stays inside her mist.
Wait out Hallowed Mist instead of chasing. Enemy attacks and spells aimed at Gwen from outside it are destroyed, so save your abilities until she leaves it.
Use Inferno Aegis when you fight Gwen; the shield and speed boost help you close in and survive her attacks.
Jump on Gwen early, before she has built up her attacks. Her damage needs several hits to get going.
Hit Gwen with Emberstrike attacks as she skirmishes; they cut its cooldown, so you can fire it again soon.
Use Molten Burst on Hecarim as he charges in; he is slowed, which makes it easier to stay near him and keep hitting.
Cast Inferno Aegis when Hecarim runs at you; the shield soaks his burst and the explosion hurts him if he stays close.
Don't fight Hecarim right after he lines up Devastating Charge from far away; it knocks you back and hits hard when he has traveled far.
Bring Dragon's Descent into a fight only when your Fury is full, then fight Hecarim in Dragon Form so Emberstrike and Molten Burst get stronger.
Stay close to Hecarim and keep hitting him with Emberstrike; he has little way to stop you once you are on him.
Ivern can't attack or be attacked by most jungle monsters, so he clears by freeing camps. Use that to track him: a camp that grows a grove is one he is taking.
Cast Dragon's Descent over Ivern and his allies in a fight; the enemies it hits flee and can't escape, which breaks up his peel.
Dodge Rootcaller when you walk toward him; if it hits, you are rooted and open to Daisy and his team.
Use Inferno Aegis when you walk into brush fights; the shield and speed help you reach him before he slips away.
Aim Molten Burst at him as he retreats; it slows him, so you can catch up.
Keep your distance from Jarvan and stay out of the line between him and his Demacian Standard. Otherwise Dragon Strike knocks you up.
Use Inferno Aegis for the shield and the speed boost when you close in on Jarvan. It is strongest when he is near you.
Fly out of Cataclysm's walls with Dragon's Descent once you have enough Fury. Movement abilities can pass through the terrain.
Hit Jarvan with Molten Burst to slow him while you attack. Aim it so he cannot get away.
Don't auto-attack Jax while Counter Strike is up; you will miss and he then stuns you. Step back or use abilities until it ends.
Hit Jax with Molten Burst as he leaps in; it slows him, and you can stay on him with Emberstrike.
Use Inferno Aegis when Jax commits; the shield soaks his burst and the speed lets you chase or leave.
Jax gets stronger the longer he keeps hitting you with Relentless Assault. Break his attack chain by backing off and re-engaging.
Save Dragon's Descent to jump on Jax once Counter Strike is spent; the fear stops his attack chain.
Stay close to Jayce. Shyvana gains power from hitting him, and he is weak when you reach him in melee, so close the gap with Dragon's Descent.
When Jayce is in Cannon form, fight him up close with Emberstrike. Don't stand at range and trade shots with him.
Use Inferno Aegis when you go in on Jayce. The shield and the speed boost toward him help you reach him.
Hit Jayce with Molten Burst so he is slowed and can't kite you easily. In Dragon Form it also pierces and leaves a damaging trail.
Close the gap with Inferno Aegis; the shield and extra speed toward Karthus let you reach him through his poke.
Use Dragon's Descent to jump onto Karthus; he is hurt a lot once you are on him.
Do not walk through Wall of Pain if you can walk around; it slows you and cuts your Magic Resist.
Step away from his corpse after you kill him; Death Defied lets him keep casting.
Stay healthy enough to survive Requiem, and back off to heal when you are low.
Aim Molten Burst at him as he backs away; it slows him so you can catch him.
Fight Kayn once you have Dragon's Descent ready; the fear and extra health let you win a straight fight, so look for him after you land the first hit.
Hit Kayn with Molten Burst when he runs away; he is slowed and easier to catch, and the fireball goes a long way.
Turn on Inferno Aegis when Kayn jumps in or you fight him; the shield grows with each enemy champion nearby and you run faster toward him.
Chain your Emberstrike recasts into your basic attacks when you trade; each attack is reset, so you deal a lot in a short fight.
Stay near your laner or camps when Kha'Zix is around; alone, you take far more damage from Taste Their Fear.
When Kha'Zix leaps in, turn on Inferno Aegis; the shield soaks his burst and the detonation hurts him if he stays close.
Use Molten Burst on Kha'Zix when he runs; it leaves him slowed so you can catch him.
Fight him once his Leap is on cooldown; he has few ways to escape or dive then.
Trade with Emberstrike autos when he comes to you; keep attacking to refill your Dragon Fury for Dragon's Descent.
Dive Kindred when she is out of position. Dragon's Descent makes you unstoppable, and its fear stops her from kiting you.
Close the gap with Inferno Aegis; it gives you extra move speed, more when you run toward enemy champions, so Kindred can't just walk away.
Use Molten Burst to get her slowed before you commit. A slowed Kindred can't back away from your attacks.
Don't use your full burst while Lamb's Respite is active. Enemies inside can't die, so wait for it to end.
Chain your Emberstrike hits when you fight her; she is fragile and takes heavy damage from your attacks.
Stay close to Lee Sin and keep attacking. Your damage and Dragon Fury come from hitting him, and he is weak when he cannot chain his abilities.
Use Inferno Aegis when Lee Sin dives in; the shield and speed help you survive and stay on him.
Aim Molten Burst at Lee Sin as he leaves or chases. It slows him, and he takes magic damage, which his Iron Will does not reduce.
Stay away from your teammates when Lee Sin has Dragon's Rage; a kick that sends him into allies hurts them.
Use Molten Burst on Lillia when she runs away; the slow makes her easier to catch and she cannot kite you freely.
Cast Dragon's Descent only when you can land on her; she will struggle to escape once you are on top of her.
Open a fight with Inferno Aegis; the shield absorbs her poke and the speed boost lets you close the gap.
Stay on her with Emberstrike attacks instead of chasing without hitting; its attacks reset and shorten the cooldown.
Stay close and keep hitting Master Yi. Emberstrike resets your attacks, and Inferno Aegis gives you a shield and speed to trade with him.
Do not rely on Molten Burst to catch him once Highlander is active; he is immune to slows.
Hit him a few times when he heals with Meditate so he burns mana. Do not chase him while he channels, because he takes much less damage then.
Save Dragon's Descent to fear him when he dives in. He can't act while he is in the fear.
Wait a moment before using abilities when Wukong disappears; Warrior Trickster leaves a clone, so hit the real one.
Use Inferno Aegis when Wukong dives in with Nimbus Strike. The shield absorbs his burst and the blast hurts him.
Hit Wukong with Molten Burst to keep him slowed when he tries to chase or run away.
Do not stand next to your allies when Wukong uses Cyclone. It knocks everyone up and hurts their max Health.
Do not fight Wukong in a long, drawn-out trade. He gets sturdier with every hit.
Cast Molten Burst at Naafiri when she backs off or jumps in; it slows her, and in Dragon Form it pierces through her packmates to reach her.
Use Inferno Aegis when Naafiri commits to you; the shield soaks her burst and the blast hurts her and her packmates.
Fight Naafiri with Emberstrike ready and keep attacking; each hit shortens its cooldown and the extra casts add damage.
Hold Dragon's Descent until Naafiri jumps on you or tries to escape; it makes enemies flee and you can fly past her.
Stay close to Nidalee and keep attacking. Emberstrike gets your attacks going and she is weak in melee range.
Walk around brush carefully, because Nidalee can hide traps there. A Bushwhack trap deals damage over time and lets her find you.
Use Inferno Aegis when you walk toward her; the shield soaks up a Javelin Toss and you move faster toward enemy champions.
Aim Molten Burst at her when she is Hunted or running away; it slows her. In dragon form it passes through enemies.
Save Dragon's Descent to close the gap when she is hurt or has used her traps. It makes you unstoppable on the way in.
Save Inferno Aegis to meet Nocturne when he jumps in; the shield absorbs his burst.
Do not throw Molten Burst into Shroud of Darkness; wait until his shield is gone.
Move away from Nocturne when Unspeakable Horror starts; the tether breaks with distance and the fear never lands.
Stay near your allies when Paranoia goes off; his jump needs you to be alone.
Stay out of Biggest Snowball Ever!'s path and turn sharply when it comes at you. It is fast but turns slowly.
Use Inferno Aegis when Nunu and Willump get close; the shield and speed help you stay in the fight. Recast it to damage them.
Walk out of Snowball Barrage after the first volley hits, so you dodge the root that follows.
Fly out with Dragon's Descent before Absolute Zero grows strong, or step out of its area. Flash also escapes it.
Chain attacks with Emberstrike in short fights; each hit lowers its cooldown, so you trade well against Nunu and Willump up close.
Keep hitting Pantheon with attacks; Emberstrike is powered by your attacks and its cooldown shortens with every hit.
Do not fight Pantheon face to face while Aegis Assault is up; walk around him or wait until it ends.
Use Inferno Aegis when Pantheon jumps in; the shield soaks his burst and the blast hurts him back.
Stay healthy near Pantheon; a thrown Comet Spear hits very hard when you are low.
Step out of the marked area when Grand Starfall starts; Pantheon takes a while to land, so move away.
Use Molten Burst to slow Qiyana when she dashes in, then fight her with Emberstrike while she is slowed.
Cast Inferno Aegis before you trade with Qiyana. The shield soaks her burst, and the explosion hurts her if she stays close.
Save Dragon's Descent for when Qiyana is close or about to dash in. Dragon Form makes you sturdier and your abilities hit harder.
Stay near Qiyana and keep hitting her. Shyvana gets stronger by attacking, and Qiyana wants to hit and leave.
Don't attack Rammus while Defensive Ball Curl is up. It hurts you for each attack and he is very tanky; wait for it to end.
Keep your distance from Rammus when Frenzying Taunt is ready, or he can force you to attack him. Look for a moment when it is on cooldown.
Use Molten Burst from range to slow Rammus and hit him as he rolls at you. Rammus is weakest when Defensive Ball Curl is off.
Use Inferno Aegis when Rammus rolls in with Powerball. It gives you a shield and speed to take the hit and go.
Stay close to Rek'Sai and keep hitting her; Shyvana is strongest when she is attacking, and Rek'Sai's Tunnel lets her slip away if you hang back.
Use Inferno Aegis when you fight Rek'Sai. The shield and extra Move Speed help you close in and trade.
Use Molten Burst on Rek'Sai as she backs away; it leaves her slowed and easier to catch.
Be careful when her Fury is full, because Furious Bite then deals true damage. Don't take a long trade with her at that point.
Keep Dragon's Descent for when you have full Fury. In Dragon Form you are Unstoppable, so you can dive in and fight her through crowd control.
Cast Inferno Aegis when Rengar leaps in or jumps you; the shield grows with each nearby enemy champion and the burst hurts him.
Hold Molten Burst for when Rengar runs away or closes in; it leaves him slowed and he can't easily catch you or escape.
Stay away from brush when you think Rengar is near, because he can leap out of it onto you.
Fight him in Dragon Form; Dragon's Descent makes you sturdier and makes your abilities stronger, and its fear stops his burst.
Use Emberstrike in every trade; the extra attacks hit hard and keep your Dragon Fury building.
Keep Inferno Aegis up when Sejuani's team starts a fight; the shield grows with each nearby enemy champion and the burst hurts them all.
Aim Molten Burst at Sejuani as she charges in; it slows her, but her Frost Armor can stop it from working while she is armored.
Do not stand in a line with your team in dragon form's path of Glacial Prison; sidestep the bola, because a stun there loses you the fight.
Use Dragon's Descent when you need to escape or finish a fight; you are unstoppable while you fly, so it can get you out of a stun setup.
Do not chase Shaco blindly into fog; Jack In The Box can hide anywhere and will fear and root you.
Use Inferno Aegis when Shaco jumps on you; the shield soaks his burst and the move speed helps you catch him.
Hit Shaco with Molten Burst to slow him when he is visible; he is fragile once caught.
Keep Shaco's Hallucinate clone in mind; when it dies it explodes and drops boxes, so kill it away from your team.
Face Shaco when he vanishes; his Deceive attack from behind is a critical strike, so do not give him your back.
Do not cluster with allies when you fight Skarner. Keep your distance until you are ready to trade.
Watch for Skarner charging with Ixtal's Impact. Stay away from walls, or he can stun you by slamming you into one.
Save Dragon's Descent as an escape or a way to dodge Impale. You are unstoppable while you fly.
Use Molten Burst to slow Skarner as he closes in, then hit him with Emberstrike.
Inferno Aegis gives you a shield and speed when Skarner is near. Use it to take his hits and then trade back.
Fight Sylas up close and keep attacking him; Emberstrike and your attacks do the most when you stay on him, and he is weaker if you stay out of his chains.
Cast Inferno Aegis as you close in on Sylas; the shield soaks his burst and the speed boost helps you catch him.
Sidestep Abduct; if Sylas misses, he has no quick way onto you and you can go in on him.
Aim Molten Burst at Sylas as he steps up; it slows him and his dashes stay shorter.
Do not trade into a Sylas with low health when he has Kingslayer ready; he heals back a lot from hitting you.
Use Dragon's Descent when Sylas is no longer able to run from you; he can steal it with Hijack, so go in when his ultimate is down.
Keep Inferno Aegis for when Talon jumps on you. The shield soaks his burst, and the blast hurts him if he stays.
Talon's damage is all physical, so Scalemail from takedowns helps you survive his burst.
Hit Talon with Molten Burst when he lands to slow him. He has trouble escaping while slowed.
Use Dragon's Descent to catch Talon once Shadow Assault is spent. He is much easier to kill without his escape.
Use Emberstrike on Talon the moment he commits to an attack. It adds damage in a fight you want to keep short.
Do not chase Trundle into his Frozen Domain; he is far stronger there. Pull the fight outside it.
Leave Pillar of Ice quickly; it slows you, and Trundle uses it to block your escape or your chase.
Use Inferno Aegis when Trundle commits to you; the shield and Move Speed help you fight back, and the blast hurts him.
Fire Molten Burst at Trundle as he walks up; it slows him and chips his health.
Trundle's Chomp lowers your Attack Damage, so avoid long trades after you take it; back off until it wears off.
Do not stand still when Udyr is near; his Blazing Stampede attack dashes onto you and stuns. Use Inferno Aegis for its shield and speed.
Fire Molten Burst at Udyr as he approaches; it slows him, and the fireball is bigger in dragon form.
Use Dragon's Descent to escape or finish a fight; Shyvana is Unstoppable while flying, and the fear can break his chase.
Cast Inferno Aegis when Vi starts her fight; the shield grows with each enemy champion nearby and you run faster toward them.
Fire Molten Burst at Vi as she charges Vault Breaker; she is slowed while charging, so it is easy to land and slows her more.
Don't trade in a long brawl once Vi has hit you three times; she cuts your Armor and attacks faster. Break off or use Emberstrike to finish quickly.
Dragon's Descent makes you unstoppable as you fly, so use it to start a fight or escape when Vi tries to lock you down.
Start your fight with Inferno Aegis; the shield and speed let you close on Viego, and it grows with every enemy champion nearby.
Hit Viego with Molten Burst before he gets away; it leaves him slowed so you can keep attacking.
Chain your Emberstrike casts between attacks. They reset your attack timer and build your Dragon Fury quickly in a fight.
Use Dragon's Descent once your Dragon Fury is full. Fight Viego in Dragon Form, where your abilities hit harder and have extra effects.
Stay close to Viego. His stun from Spectral Maw is blocked by the first unit it hits, so fight with minions or monsters between you only when it helps you.
Pull Volibear's Thundering Smash stun out of him by keeping your distance; if he cannot reach you, his burst is wasted.
Throw Molten Burst at Volibear as he runs in so he is slowed and you keep space.
Use Inferno Aegis when he jumps on you; the shield and detonation punish him for coming close.
Fight him in dragon form: Emberstrike gets an extra bite and Molten Burst pierces, which helps against his healing from Frenzied Maul.
Stay out of Warwick's reach when he is hunting you; Jaws of the Beast can follow your dashes if he holds it.
Keep your health up; Warwick speeds toward you and attacks faster once you are low.
Use Inferno Aegis when Warwick closes in; the shield and extra speed help you survive his trade.
Aim Molten Burst at Warwick as he approaches; it slows him and gives you space.
Keep hitting Warwick with attacks to refill your Dragon's Descent fury, then transform to win the fight.
Stay out of Xin Zhao's reach. Audacious Charge goes farther on a Challenged target, so do not trade in his range.
Use Inferno Aegis when Xin Zhao starts his Three Talon Strike combo. The shield and extra speed blunt his burst and help you reset the fight.
Aim Molten Burst at Xin Zhao as he closes in. It slows him, and in Dragon Form it passes through enemies.
Do not stand in the sweep range of Crescent Guard. He takes no damage from enemies outside it for a few seconds, so back off and wait out that window.
Stay away from Zac's goo chunks; step on them to destroy them so he cannot heal from them.
Kill every bloblet when Zac splits apart, or he comes back. Use Inferno Aegis to hit several bloblets at once while in Dragon Form.
Use Molten Burst on Zac when he charges Elastic Slingshot; being slowed makes his landing easier to avoid.
Fight Zac when your Dragon Fury is full, so Dragon's Descent makes you Unstoppable and carries you through his crowd control.
Keep attacking in a long fight; each hit shortens Emberstrike's cooldown, and its Dragon Form bite deals true damage.
Use Inferno Aegis when Zed dives in; the shield grows with him nearby and the blast hurts him if he stays close.
Hit Zed with Molten Burst as he closes in; it leaves him slowed so you can catch him or trade on your terms.
Fight Zed in the first part of a duel with Emberstrike, since attacking keeps its cooldown short.
Dragon's Descent makes you unstoppable as you fly in, so use it to chase Zed down after he swaps away.
Gain Scalemail from kills on large monsters; the extra armor and magic resist makes Zed's damage weaker.
Fly in with Dragon's Descent when Zyra is out of position; it scatters her and gives you a quick way to close the gap.
Walk over Zyra's seeds before she grows them. Stepping on one destroys it, but it briefly reveals you.
Pop Inferno Aegis before Zyra's burst lands; the shield and extra speed help you reach her.
Avoid fighting Zyra in areas thick with her plants. Take the fight somewhere she has no seeds.
Keep hitting Zyra with Emberstrike once you reach her; her squishy body takes a lot of damage from you.
